title: Tech View starts with List's default columns and saved List choices stay
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. A brand-new user who has never changed any Work Orders columns (e.g. "Nora New", created under Settings > Staff with an Admin role), signed in in a second browser.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • Leave Lead Technician empty.
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
custom_steps:
1. As Nora New open Work Orders in List and write down every column shown.
  2. Pick Tech View and write down every column shown.
  3. Open Tech View's column chooser and read whether Assigned Techs is on.
  4. As your own user, open List, turn Service Advisor off and Created on on, then reload.
  5. Pick Tech View, change any column there, pick List again and reload.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Nora New's Tech View shows exactly the same columns as her List default (the production List defaults); Assigned Techs is off until she turns it on.
  • Your List keeps Service Advisor off and Created on on after every switch and reload: saved List choices stay exactly as they are. (Choices saved before this release cannot be recreated by hand; write 'pre-release List choice not checked' unless you have such a user.)

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-R4, S5-R12, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions FF-7 / DR-21. Tech plan §3.9 records the production default List columns. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R4: “Until the user changes Tech View’s columns, Tech View shows the current production List default columns.”
  • S5-R12: “Existing saved List column selections stay exactly as they are.”
  • Tech plan §3.9 (default List columns): “Default List columns = every non-required column except `invoicedDate`, `daysOpen`, `partRequestsCount`, `partReturnRequestsCount`, `unreceivedPartRequestsCount`.”
